welcome.title: Welcome to Córdoba 5579
welcome.subtitle: Welcome Letter & Directions
welcome.intro:
Hello and welcome to Buenos Aires!

We are delighted to have you as our guest at Córdoba 5579. This apartment was thoughtfully designed and equipped to offer you a premium, comfortable, and unforgettable stay in one of the city's finest neighborhoods: Palermo Hollywood.

We have prepared this detailed house manual to help you get acquainted with the apartment, its appliances, and building rules. Please read it carefully to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience.

Jorge Orlando (project manager) and our entire team are at your complete disposal to assist you. Enjoy your stay!
welcome.directions_intro: The building is located at Av. Córdoba 5579, between Fitz Roy and Humboldt streets, Palermo Hollywood, CABA.

directions.title: By Car or Ride-Hailing Apps:
directions.content: From Ezeiza (EZE) or Aeroparque (AEP), we strongly recommend using Uber or Cabify for safety and convenient payment. Access is direct via Av. Córdoba. The building has no private garage; paid commercial garages are 50m away.

directions.title: By Subway (Line D):
directions.content: The nearest stations are Ministro Carranza (5 blocks away) or Palermo. Line D connects directly to Downtown, Plaza de Mayo, and Recoleta.

directions.title: By Train (Mitre Line):
directions.content: Ministro Carranza Station (Mitre Line) is located just 5 blocks from the building.

directions.title: By Bus (Metrobus):
directions.content: Multiple bus lines stop right in front on Av. Córdoba (140, 151, 168) or nearby on Av. Santa Fe and Av. Juan B. Justo Metrobus corridors.

local_tips.title: Local Tourist Survival Tips
local_tips.subtitle: Money, transport & essential tips
local_tips.intro: Essential information for international travelers visiting Buenos Aires:

items.title: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (SUBE Card)
items.content: In Buenos Aires, buses and subways do not accept cash. You must buy a rechargeable SUBE card (available at subway stations or large kiosks) and top it up before riding. One card can be shared by multiple travelers on the same journey.

items.title: MONEY & EXCHANGE RATES (USD in Argentina)
items.content:
Argentina operates with multiple exchange rates. Key options for tourists:
• Official Dollar: Traditional bank rate, least favorable for tourists.
• Blue Dollar (Parallel): Free market rate, higher value. Traded in cash at exchange houses.
• MEP Dollar (Card): The recommended option! Paying with foreign credit/debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) automatically converts your spend at near-Blue rates. It is safe, legal, and convenient for restaurants and supermarkets.

Scan the QR code to check real-time exchange rates.

checkin.title: Self Check-In Guide
checkin.subtitle: Step-by-step entry instructions
checkin.intro: For your convenience and schedule flexibility, check-in is 100% autonomous starting at 3:00 PM (15:00 hs). Please follow these detailed steps to enter:

steps.content: Locate the metal key lockbox labeled 'Depto 101' installed on the outer wall to the right of the building main entrance (Av. Córdoba 5579).
Enter the 4-digit combination code sent to you via Airbnb message a few hours prior to arrival.
Slide the side release latch down and open the lockbox compartment to retrieve your set of keys.
Tap the blue/black magnetic fob against the circular electronic reader on the entrance wall. The glass lobby door will unlock automatically.
Enter the lobby and head up to the 1st floor via elevator or stairs. Apartment is Unit 101. Use the physical key to unlock the main front door.

checkin.caution:
• Never share the lockbox code with unregistered third parties.
• After taking the keys, close the lockbox and scramble the number dials so the code is not exposed.

rules.title: House & Building Rules
rules.subtitle: Community guidelines & regulations
rules.intro: To ensure a pleasant stay and maintain great relations with building neighbors, please strictly observe internal regulations:

items.title: NO SMOKING
items.content: Smoking traditional or electronic cigarettes inside the apartment, balcony, or hallways is strictly prohibited. Smoking is only allowed outdoors on the 11th-floor rooftop terrace.

items.title: NO PETS
items.content: Pets of any kind are not permitted under any circumstances.

items.title: QUIET HOURS & NO PARTIES
items.content: Parties, events, and loud noise are strictly prohibited. Building quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please respect neighbors' rest.

items.title: NO UNREGISTERED GUESTS
items.content: For safety, common amenities (pool, SUM, laundry) are strictly for registered guests. External visitors are not allowed in amenity areas.

items.title: DRESS CODE
items.content: Walking shirtless or in swimwear in hallways, elevators, or lobby is strictly prohibited. Proper attire is required (swimwear allowed only in pool area).

rules.penalty: PENALTIES & FINES: Violations of building regulations incur heavy HOA fines, which will be charged directly to the guest.

climate_safe.title: Apartment Guide - Access & Climate
climate_safe.subtitle: Door locks, air conditioning & safe box
climate_safe.door:
1. Main Door Lock:
The front door lock automatically latches upon closing. Push or pull firmly to ensure it catches properly.
Important! Always carry your keys with you when stepping out to prevent lockouts.
climate_safe.ac_intro:
2. Air Conditioning & Climate:
The apartment features two split AC units (living room & bedroom) with hot/cool modes.

ac_items.title: Turning On:
ac_items.content: Use the remote control for each unit. Press power and select COOL or HEAT mode.

ac_items.title: Recommended Temp:
ac_items.content: Set to 24 °C (75 °F) in summer and 22 °C (71 °F) in winter for optimal energy efficiency.

ac_items.title: Common Mistakes:
ac_items.content: Do not operate AC units with windows or balcony door open. This overworks the compressor and reduces cooling efficiency.

ac_items.title: Eco Friendly:
ac_items.content: Always turn off AC units when leaving the apartment to conserve energy.

climate_safe.safe_content:
A mechanical key-operated safe box is located inside the bedroom closet for your valuables.
Note: The key to the safe is attached to your main apartment key ring.
climate_safe.wifi_content:
Network Name (SSID): Cordoba5579_Guest
Password: Welcome101
Scan the QR code on the left with your phone camera to automatically connect to the Wi-Fi network without typing the password manually.
climate_safe.sofa_bed_intro: The living room includes a comfortable 2-person pull-out sofa bed. Follow these step-by-step instructions:

sofa_bed_steps.content: Remove backrest cushions and set aside.
Pull the lower metal handle upward and outward.
Unfold the metal frame leg supports onto the floor.
Place the 600-thread-count Egyptian cotton sheet set.
Arrange extra pillows (located in bedroom closet).

climate_safe.sofa_bed_tip:
FOLDING SAFETY TIP:
When closing the sofa bed back up, lift from the center of the metal frame without forcing the hinges. Ensure that sheets or blankets are not caught in the folding metal mechanism.

kitchen.title: Apartment Guide - Kitchen & Appliances
kitchen.subtitle: Appliances & specialty coffee maker
kitchen.intro: The kitchen is fully equipped with Samsung appliances and Carol dinnerware for your stay:

items.title: Electric Cooktop:
items.content: Stainless steel electric resistance burner. Do not place wet pan bottoms on hot elements and allow to cool before cleaning. No built-in wall oven.

items.title: Countertop Oven & Air Fryer:
items.content: Includes a countertop electric oven combined with Air Fryer. Use wooden or silicone tools to protect non-stick surfaces.

items.title: Coffee Maker & Milk Frother:
items.content: Specialty coffee maker with built-in milk frother. Ideal for espresso, lattes, or cappuccino. Clean filter after use.

items.title: Fridge, Microwave & Toaster:
items.content: Samsung refrigerator with digital temp control. No metals in microwave. Electric kettle and toaster are on the counter.

items.title: Rice Cooker & Blender:
items.content: High-power blender with glass jar and electric rice cooker for quick meal prep.

amenities.title: Building Amenities - Laundry & SUM
amenities.subtitle: Rooftop terrace, pool & laundry room
amenities.laundry_intro:
1. Shared Building Laundry:
The building features a shared laundry room for guests on the 10th floor.

laundry_items.title: Equipment:
laundry_items.content: Equipped with commercial washing machines free for guest use. Note that there is no tumble dryer in the building laundry room.

laundry_items.title: Drying Clothes:
laundry_items.content: A folding portable clothes drying rack is provided inside your apartment closet to dry clothes in the unit or balcony.

laundry_items.title: Laundry Supplies:
laundry_items.content: Detergent and fabric softener are not included (can be purchased at nearby supermarkets).

amenities.sum_intro:
2. Rooftop Terrace, SUM & Barbecue (11th Floor):
The building features an enclosed Multi-Purpose Room (SUM) and outdoor Argentine grill (parrilla) with panoramic views on the 11th floor.

sum_items.title: Prior Reservation:
sum_items.content: Using the grill or enclosed SUM requires prior reservation with host Jorge. He coordinates with administration, and you collect/return the key with the building manager on the 8th floor.

sum_items.title: Cleaning Fee:
sum_items.content: A mandatory cleaning fee fixed by building administration applies ($10,000 ARS at manual creation). Confirm current rate with Jorge when reserving.

sum_items.title: Pool & Solarium:
sum_items.content: Free access from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM on the 11th floor. Taking a shower before entering is mandatory. Prohibited: pets, smoking, food/drinks in pool area, running, or inflables/balls.

cleaning.title: Cleaning, Trash & Hygiene
cleaning.subtitle: Disposal rules & towel replacement
cleaning.garbage:
1. Waste Management & Location (Emergency Stairwell Bins):
Where are the bins located? Upon leaving Apartment 101, the 1st door to your right along the same wall is the Emergency Stairwell. Bins are located inside on the landing.
• Black Bin (Wet/Organic Trash): Food scraps, wet waste, dirty paper/cardboard, etc.
• Green Bin (Recyclables): Glass, metal, plastic, paper & cardboard (MUST ALWAYS BE CLEAN AND DRY).
Building Administration Rules (Adm. Steinberg):
• Always tie trash bags securely with a double knot. Prohibited to pour liquids inside bags.
• Prohibited to discard delivery bags or boxes directly into the bins as they take up too much space.
• If the bins are full, take the trash bag directly to the public container on the street.
cleaning.plumbing_intro:
2. Plumbing & Toilet Care:
The building drainage system is sensitive to blockages. Please strictly adhere to the following rule:
cleaning.plumbing_warning:
ATTENTION! WHAT NOT TO FLUSH:
• Strictly prohibited to flush wet wipes, feminine products, cotton, diapers, or paper towels.
• Use normal toilet paper in moderate amounts. Discard all other trash in the bathroom bin.
cleaning.linen:
3. Linens & Towels Policy:
• Unit is delivered fully sanitized with clean sheets and towels.
• Stays over 7 nights include a fresh towel set replacement.
• Stays of 14+ nights include full sheet & towel replacement + complimentary light cleaning.

security.title: Security, Outages & Emergencies
security.subtitle: Emergency numbers, circuit breaker & safety
security.intro: Your safety is our top priority. Please follow these protocols during an emergency:

items.title: ELEVATORS (CONDOR)
items.content: Maintenance: Condor elevators (Max capacity: 450 KG / 6 people). In case of malfunction or entrapment, call 24h Guard: 4599-4590 or 4581-0605 / 4583-1926.

items.title: CIRCUIT BREAKER PANEL
items.content: In case of partial power loss inside the unit (e.g. overload from appliances), check the circuit breaker panel behind the main front door. Flip up any tripped breaker.

items.title: KEY LOSS POLICY
items.content: If you lose physical keys or the electronic fob, report it immediately to Jorge. Replacement key & fob fees apply per building safety regulations.

items.title: MEDICAL EMERGENCIES
items.content:
For ambulance emergencies call 107 (SAME).
• Hospital Fernández: Av. Cerviño 3356, Palermo (Adult general hospital).
• Hospital de Niños Ricardo Gutiérrez: Gallo 1330, Recoleta (Pediatric).

guide.title: Neighborhood Guide & Attractions
guide.subtitle: Palermo Hollywood highlights near Córdoba 5579
guide.intro: Palermo Hollywood is one of the safest, liveliest, and most artistic neighborhoods in Buenos Aires. Top nearby spots:

items.title: Supermarkets:
items.content:
• Carrefour Express: Nearby locations (e.g. Fitz Roy & Niceto Vega) for quick groceries.
• Jumbo Palermo: (Av. Bullrich 345) Large hypermarket for full groceries and prime meats.

items.title: Pharmacies (24/7):
items.content: • Farmacity: Multiple locations. Nearest is on Av. Juan B. Justo, offering 24/7 service.

items.title: Specialty Coffee:
items.content:
• Cuervo Café: (Costa Rica 5801) Excellent beans and trendy atmosphere.
• Lattente: (Thames 1891) A classic spot for specialty coffee lovers.
• Surry Hills Coffee: (Borges 1772) Australian-style brunch and pastries.

items.title: Top Restaurants:
items.content:
• Don Julio: (Guatemala 4691) World-famous steakhouse. Booking months in advance required.
• La Mar Cebichería: (Arévalo 2024) High-end Peruvian ceviche in a beautiful courtyard.
• Niño Gordo: (Thames 1810) Asian fusion steakhouse with striking decor.
• Sacro: (Costa Rica 6038) High-end plant-based dining in a sophisticated setting.

items.title: Bars & Nightlife:
items.content:
• Uptown: (Arévalo 2030) Speakeasy bar designed like a NYC subway station.
• Victoria Brown: (Costa Rica 4827) Craft cocktails hidden behind a secret door.

items.title: Attractions & Shopping:
items.content:
• Distrito Arcos: Premium open-air outlet mall in historic railway arches, 10 min walk.
• Mercado de las Pulgas: (Álvarez Thomas & Dorrego) Antique market with vintage art & decor.
• Movistar Arena: Top arena for international concerts, 15 min walk.

guide.tip: Safety Tip: Palermo Hollywood is very safe and active, but always keep your belongings in sight and avoid holding phones loosely in crowded outdoor areas.

items.q: Can I request early check-in or late check-out?
items.a: Subject to calendar availability. Contact Jorge in advance to check schedule and any extra fees.

items.q: Can I leave luggage in the building before check-in or after check-out?
items.a: Building HOA regulations strictly prohibit luggage storage in common areas or the lobby. We recommend apps like Bounce or LuggageHero to store luggage securely at nearby Palermo stores for a low hourly rate.

items.q: Is there a laundry service or tumble dryer?
items.a: All guests have free access to commercial washing machines in the 10th-floor laundry room. Note that there is no tumble dryer in the building; a portable drying rack is in your apartment closet.

items.q: How do I reserve the SUM / Barbecue (Parrilla) and what is the fee?
items.a: Reserve in advance via WhatsApp with Jorge. Building HOA charges a mandatory $10,000 ARS cleaning fee. You collect and return the keys to the 8th-floor building manager.

items.q: What appliances are available in the kitchen?
items.a: The kitchen is equipped with a Samsung refrigerator with freezer, stainless steel electric cooktop, electric oven with Air Fryer, espresso coffee machine with milk frother, glass blender, electric kettle, rice cooker, and toaster.

items.q: Does the bedroom safe box have a physical key?
items.a: Yes, the bedroom safe box operates with a mechanical key attached to your main apartment key ring.
